stage_a.note: Very strong positive expression; communicates pronounced, sustained positive engagement throughout the pitch and dance routine.
Pronounced, sustained engagement and excitement characterize the presentation; he is highly animated about his program.
A pronounced and sustained approachable, considerate orientation; he warmly invites the investors to participate.

venture.description: A dance fitness certification program and consumer DVD line that makes working out fun and accessible.
venture.note: The pitch focuses on seeking capital to expand the instructor certification program nationwide.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 presents his dance fitness certification program, shares his background, and demonstrates the workout with his team.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: S4 jokes that he thinks he lost 20 pounds just by watching the energetic dance presentation.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: S3 compliments the routine, noting that it was fun and full of high energy.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: S4 asks if the investment is intended for launching a consumer product, noting the high costs involved.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 clarifies he is seeking funds for his instructor certification program, as he already has consumer DVDs out.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: S1 asks to clarify if the consumer products and the certification program operate as two entirely separate businesses.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 confirms they are two separate businesses and explains his goal is to train teachers to lead the workouts.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: S1 asks F1 to explain the specific business model and pricing for the instructor certification program.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 explains that instructors pay a 250 dollar fee to attend a course and get certified for one year.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: S5 asks F1 how he plans to scale the certification business and expand it to a wider audience.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 explains his strategy involves selecting 10 master trainers in each city to host certifications and expand the reach.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: S5 asks for the current revenue figures of the combined businesses.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 admits he does not know the revenue yet because the DVDs have only just been released.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: S1 challenges F1 for asking them to invest in the wholesale business without offering a share of the retail side.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: S5 agrees with S1, arguing that since F1 is the brand, the two businesses must be combined for investors.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 asks F1 directly if he is willing to combine the two businesses into one deal.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 agrees to combine them, stating he believes it is important to bundle them together.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: S3 asks F1 to explain his background and history with Tae Bo and his father.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 explains that his father created Tae Bo, noting it was the highest selling fitness DVD in history.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: S3 asks if his father invested in his business, suggesting he should be a big believer in the concept.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 explains his family structure is different and frankly calls his father a cheapskate regarding financial support.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: S4 jokes that his father is simply making him earn his success on his own merits.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: S3 asks how F1 managed to build the business by himself without his father's financial backing.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 credits his wife as his support system, revealing they were homeless while building the workout program.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 asks for confirmation, visibly surprised that F1 and his wife were homeless.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 confirms that they were indeed homeless.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: S5 asks if F1 is estranged from his father and whether his father knew they were homeless.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 says they were not close but mentions that things are starting to move in a better direction.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: S3 asks if F1 has the legal rights to use the name Billy Blanks Jr in all commercial manners.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 confirms it has not been an issue and states his father knows about his contracts and business.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: S3 decides to exit, stating that the business model itself is not clear enough to her.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: S5 exits, expressing respect for F1's story but feeling he is not the right business partner.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: S4 exits, stating that while F1 is a great guy, it is not a suitable investment for him.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 mentions his tight strategic relationship with Zumba, suggesting it could be a valuable asset to the investors.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 offers 100k for 50 percent, contingent on Zumba agreeing to distribute the program, inviting S1 to join.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: S1 joins S2's offer under the stated contingency involving Zumba.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 asks S2 to confirm that this is his official offer.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 confirms that the stated terms represent his official offer.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 expresses hesitation about bundling his program with Zumba, wanting to maintain his own distinct brand identity.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: S1 argues the deal would accelerate F1's brand quickly by leveraging Zumba's massive distribution network.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: S5 asks F1 to explain his concerns, noting the huge audience Zumba could provide.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 explains his concern that his brand will be overshadowed and seen merely as a Zumba product.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 asks the investors if he can step out briefly to discuss the offer with his wife.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 agrees to let him consult his wife, noting he was about to exit otherwise.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 explains the standing offer and the Zumba contingency to his wife outside the tank.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 asks S1 why Zumba would not just create their own dance program instead of partnering.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: S1 suggests Zumba might, but notes they do not have F1's specific brand value.

turns.speaker: F2
turns.summary: F2 expresses concern to F1 that the deal is difficult because F1 is the core brand.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 asks F1 if he is ready to accept their standing offer upon returning.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 counters, offering to bundle all his businesses for 50 percent without the Zumba contingency.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: S1 asks F1 to trust them, reiterating their goal to accelerate his brand through Zumba.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: S3 asks F1 if he would be willing to do the deal with S1 and S2.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 confirms he would be willing to partner with S1 and S2.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 asks F1 what his final decision is regarding their offer.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 rejects the offer, stating he does not think it is the right deal for him.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 officially exits and wishes F1 the best of luck.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: S3 remarks that she does not think F1 fully understood the value of the offer.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 agrees it was a mistake and expresses a strong desire to help F1 despite the rejection.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: S4 jokes that he will send F1 and his wife an invoice for his time.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 decides he will regret letting F1 walk away and leaves the tank to follow him.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 finds F1 and F2 in the hallway and urges them to reconsider the valuable distribution opportunity.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: F1 accepts the deal, expressing deep gratitude for S2's persistence and belief in them.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: S2 thanks them and promises to do his absolute best to help their business succeed.

decisions.note: As a business, it's not clear to her.
He respects his story but is not the right value business partner.
Thinks he's a great guy but it's not an investment for him.
Contingent on Billy Blanks' name and Zumba's approval to distribute.
Agrees to partner with Daymond on the Zumba contingency offer.

decisions.terms: Bundle both businesses for 50%, but no Zumba contingency
decisions.note: Wants to build his own brand, not bundle with another workout brand.
Does not think it is the right deal for him.
Wishes him the best after founder rejects the offer.
Leaves the tank to find Billy and explain the offer again.
Accepts after Daymond clarifies the contingency protects him.

record.notes: Daymond John leaves the tank and follows the founders into the hallway to convince them to take the deal, resulting in a successful negotiation off the main set.
